messages:
Elena Park: Draft ready — quick snapshot for enterprise launch: routing + webinar seed + benchmark headline. Link: https://drive.mock/redwood/enterprise-snapshot (still WIP). Need: 1) launch post headline & 3 social variants, 2) webinar hook + panel suggestion, 3) benchmark narrative (two short takes), 4) inbound lead routing fields for sales. Timeline: want publish next Tue. @Ben @Samir @Noah can you skim and call out blockers?

Ben Ortiz: skimmed — nice structure. For the launch post I'd lead with predictable economics + private deploy option. Short headline suggestion: "Predictable inference at enterprise scale." CTA: "Request a capacity consult" instead of generic demo. Social variants: one-line punch, customer quote style, and tech / benchmark lead. I'll draft those in a sec. :+1:

Samir Rao: benchmark note — avoid raw token numbers in headline. Instead: two narrative options: (A) Reliability-first: "Sustained p99 latency under X ms at production throughput" (B) Cost-first: "Cut per-token serving cost by Y% vs unmanaged infra". I need eng to confirm actual X/Y. Also we should lead with a tiny hero chart (latency vs throughput) on the brief.

Noah Li: routing notes — agree with the capacity-consult CTA. For inbound: we should capture deployment_mode (hosted/dedicated/private), sla_required (true/false), annual_commit_estimate (banded), and compliance_needs (HIPAA/SOC2/Other). Proposed HubSpot mapping:
```
if deployment_mode == "private" or sla_required == true -> assign queue: "Enterprise AE"
if annual_commit_estimate >= 250k -> flag: "Priority" and route to AE+SolutionsEng
else -> standard SDR nurture
```
Also request UTM for webinar registrations so I can filter.

Elena Park: good — Samir, can you pair with Aisha to confirm numbers? Ben, once you post social variants I'll pick the hero headline. Webinar: working title "Deploy with Confidence: private infra, SLAs, and cost control" — panel: 1 customer (finance or healthcare), 1 eng lead, 1 PM. 30 min + 10 min Q&A. Proposed date: Wed next week EMEA-friendly (11am PT). Who can moderate?

Ben Ortiz: I'll drop three social lines here (short):
- "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and costs — Redwood Inference for enterprise. Request a capacity consult: <link>"
- "Customer: ‘We cut per-token cost 40% after moving to dedicated pools’ — how we did it: <link>"
- Tech lead: "p99 latency under 120ms at steady state — see our deploy approach and SLA options. <link>"
Pick the tone you want; I prefer the first for the blog headline.

Samir Rao: pinging Aisha for numbers. Aisha — can we say p95/p99 bands for a 512-token median workload on our recent benchmark? If not, I'll use conservative phrasing.

Aisha (eng-ops): Quick confirm — for the public benchmark snapshot we can say: "p95 < 120ms, p99 < 220ms at 200 tps on dedicated A100 pools with 512-token sequences (steady-state)". That's validated on the 2/26 run. If you want p99 < 150ms we need a different config (smaller batch sizes).

Noah Li: perfect — I'll set HubSpot fields as discussed and add a routing rule for "SLA required". For webinar registration form add hidden utm_source/w medium; also a checkbox to opt into a capacity consult to populate lead_score. I'll wire props this afternoon.

Elena Park: webinar moderator — @Ben can you moderate? Plan: 25 min panel + 15 min AMAs. Samir, pls send 3 speaker questions. Also create a 1-pager slide for AE handoff with quick talking points and routing tags.

Ben Ortiz: happy to moderate. I'll also prepare a 1-slide benchmark explainer for the deck.

Samir Rao: will draft 3 Qs by EOD. Tentative Qs: 1) How did you measure production reliability before/after Redwood? 2) What SLA guarantees mattered most to your team? 3) How did cost predictability change product decisions?

launch-bot: Draft event posted to marketing calendar: "Deploy with Confidence" — Wed next week 11:00 PT. Reminder set for 72h and 24h.

Elena Park: thanks all — action items: Ben finalize social variants + slide, Samir confirm benchmarks + Qs, Noah implement routing + form fields, I'll assemble the AE 1-pager and final copy. Freeze by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
